A <br> just before </a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\">Alpha<br></a>Beta", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
